title: Proto-generated book service
summary: An MCP server generated from a .proto file by protogen: tools, resources, prompts and argument completion. Search the catalog, read a book resource, and watch book IDs complete as you type a prompt argument.
about: An MCP server generated from a .proto file by protogen.
Search the catalog with books_search, and read a book through its book:// resource template.
The prompts take a book_id, and typing one shows completions from the server.
